attribution: High_End_Pins, HEP this week post15408 (8323533), 2024; photos4,5,6,9. Replacement LED hardware, not an observed original filament.

physical_review.identity: Horizontal unhooded lamp under PARTY right-return plastic, between the spotlight and right flipper. Both HEP views show the same white replacement LED cap with a translucent yellow body behind it. It is distinct from the elevated reflector and nearby cylindrical-brass V01 bayonet. The actual socket/contact interface is hidden under the plastic.
physical_review.classification: The factory lists one F25 lamp above the right-return plastic and one F25 #555 among eleven #44 bulbs, with one laydown GI wedge holder 077-5030-00 in the parts list. The observed separate horizontal lamp in exactly that location reconciles the #555. Assigning the #555 to this location is a curation inference from these agreeing physical facts, not a per-location bulb-type label printed on PDF121 or a direct view of wedge contacts. F25 wiring is not directly traced in the photograph.
physical_review.coordinate_authority: Own visible replacement LED body center triangulated from two photos. The plastic footprint, a wire passage and a glow helper are not used as emitter coordinates.
physical_review.uncertainty_basis: Conservative allowance for partial cap occlusion, camera/UV/lens-model error, correlated art controls, coarse rounding and replacement-LED versus original-filament displacement. This is not a statistical confidence interval or manufacturing tolerance.

right-return-unhooded.camera_assumptions: Same native 1536x2048 phone lens and image pipeline across views, square pixels, no radial/tangential distortion. Physical print mapped to VPW UV bounds. No independent calibrated 3D landmarks used.
limits: Replacement LED cap/body, not observed original incandescent filament; holder/filament geometry could move the optical center along the axis.
Part of body is obscured by rail/plastic, so matching visual centers is approximate; bootstrap does not capture systematic matching or camera model errors.
RANSAC inliers are correlated SIFT features on printed art; not independently measured post or hole controls. Target is close to the hull boundary in photos 5 and 6.
The physical relationship of this lamp to the manual F25 #555 holder is assessed separately; position fit does not establish base type or circuit.
